# Lucas Rodrigues

> Software engineer specializing in React, Next.js, React Native, and TypeScript. Based in Brasília, Brazil. This portfolio helps recruiters and clients evaluate craft, shipped work, and fit for frontend/mobile roles.

Lucas builds polished web and mobile interfaces with strong UX, performance, and real product delivery. Preferred contact channels are WhatsApp and LinkedIn.
